warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical RIGHT half (the lower-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 9/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 10/21 (2.6 งานเครื่องสุขภัณฑ์และอุปกรณ์, LEFT half) extracted as _2.json.

Door/window marks (ป1-ป3, น1-น5 -- ป = ประตู/door, น = หน้าต่าง/window) are printed inline at the start of each row's รายการ description text, not in a separate ลำดับที่ column -- the ลำดับที่ column is blank for every item row on this sheet. Recorded with item_no null and the mark kept as part of the description, per spec §0.3's convention for a descriptive/inline id rather than inventing a column value that isn't printed.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet, including the 'รวมข้อ 2.5' subtotal row -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the right half (2, 4, 3, 6, 7, 2, 1, 1).
